spans.text:
Reproduce with the same provider/model/config. Do not randomly switch models
   unless the model itself is the variable being tested.
spans.note: The prompt strongly emphasizes evidence-based debugging, requiring proof before making changes. It instructs the user to reproduce issues, compare configured vs. actual state, and report observed signals rather than guessing. This promotes information integrity and truthfulness in technical diagnosis.

spans.text: Add or enable the narrowest signal that proves that boundary.
spans.note: The prompt promotes a cautious, methodical approach to debugging. It emphasizes narrowing the signal before making changes, reproducing issues before patching, and using targeted tests rather than broad changes. The structured loop (suspect, prove, reproduce, compare, patch, verify) is a safety-conscious methodology for tool and action use.
